title: Semiconductor Capital Spending Market in the US to grow by USD 7.96 billion|Key Drivers, Trends, and Market Forecasts|17000+ Technavio Research Reports
主要内容: The semiconductor capital spending market in the US is set to grow by USD 7.96 billion, progressing at a CAGR of almost 5% during 2021-2025. The market is fragmented, and the degree of fragmentation will accelerate during the forecast period. Advantest Corp., Amtech Systems Inc., Applied Materials Inc., ASM International NV, Hitachi Ltd., KLA Corp., Onto Innovation Inc., Teradyne Inc., Tokyo Electron Ltd., and Veeco Instruments Inc. are some of the major market participants. Factors such as the growing investments in fabs, the surge in demand for consumer electronics and smart electronic devices, and the miniaturization of electronic devices will offer immense growth opportunities.
